verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for a financial automation platform like Airwallex, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers one-off and bulk actions (transfers, batch transfers), event-driven webhooks, a CLI and an agent toolkit. None of it documents a recurring schedule, and a one-off batch is not a recurring job.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
